title: Loan Program Re-Review Days After a Larkspur-Side Return (Closing and Funding)
content:
In the Closing and Funding product, the re-review days of Larkspur's re-send standard are set from the loan program of the borrower's Mortgage Loan File and from the kind of return, read from the closing's latest wire return.

**Rule.** Where the settlement agent rejected Larkspur's wrong amount, the re-review days are the program's condition review turn time in business days; where Larkspur recalled the wire for an open prior-to-funding item, they are the program's underwriting turn time in business days; otherwise there are none.

A rejection carries Larkspur's wrong amount when it is a settlement agent rejection of a wire whose amount differs from the amount of the wire that funded the loan (the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date). A recall for an open prior-to-funding item is a return marked as funding conditions unmet.

| Latest wire return | Re-review days |
|---|---|
| settlement agent rejection, rejected amount differs from the funding wire | the loan program's condition review turn time (business days) |
| Larkspur recall, funding conditions unmet | the loan program's underwriting turn time (business days) |
| any other return, or none | none |

Both turn times are the program's own service levels on the Mortgage Loan File: the condition review turn time for reviewing documents received against a condition, and the underwriting turn time for the initial underwriting decision.

Hypothetical: for a program whose condition review turn time is 1 business day and underwriting turn time is 3 business days, a wrong-amount rejection gives 1 re-review day and a recall for an open condition gives 3.
